question: For evaporating sodium chlorate droplets at RH of about 59% and 34 C, what share formed single crystals without the magnetic field and with it?
trap: the 31 C row (11.8 / 26.7) or the coffee-ring column
rendered: Based on the provided text from page 4 of "Evaporative Crystallization of Sodium Chlorate Droplets under Controlled Humidity in the Presence of a Static Magnetic Field", at RH ≈ 59% and T = 34 °C, the share of droplets forming single crystals without the magnetic field is 58.8%, and with the magnetic field is 81.2%.
